description: This file contains unit tests for the OnboardingStateStore features within the OpenClaw project. It includes tests for presenting onboarding screens, persisting modes, and resetting onboarding state, all utilizing the XCTest framework with annotations for test functions and suite configuration.

classes.name: OnboardingStateStoreTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for verifying onboarding state behaviors, including presentation logic, mode persistence, and reset functionalities.

methods.name: shouldPresentWhenFreshAndDisconnected
methods.description: Tests that the onboarding should present when the app is fresh and disconnected.

methods.name: doesNotPresentWhenConnected
methods.description: Ensures onboarding does not present when the app is connected.

methods.name: markCompletedPersistsMode
methods.description: Verifies that marking onboarding as completed correctly persists the mode and affects presentation logic.

methods.name: firstRunIntroDefaultsToVisibleThenPersists
methods.description: Checks that the first run intro is visible by default and is not shown again after being marked as seen.

methods.name: resetClearsCompletionAndIntroSeen
methods.description: Ensures that resetting onboarding clears the completion state and the first run intro visibility.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates a new UserDefaults suite for testing with a unique identifier.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes persistent domain data for the test defaults to reset the state.
